Principles of Puzzle Game Design in Mario Maker

It's cool. One thing I'd like to add (I don't think he mentions it) solving the puzzles is the only option. For example when he gets to the vine part, once the player has broken the block the only option the player has is to go through the door, get another shroom, or wait out the clock. Because there are no other options the player is pretty much guaranteed to solve the puzzle the first time, even If they don't catch onto what the developer is point to. After that the player can be given more options, and the puzzle mechanic can become more complex (a la the second part of that puzzle). If you really want an idea of how this principle is applied listen/watch/play the commentary for the original portal.
